content:
What folder(s) do you see in the mobile app?

Do you have more than one account and perhaps looking at the unified inbox?

  1. Press the top left button to show the side menu.
  2. Tap the down arrow and select your account.
  3. This should display a list of folders (Inbox, Trash etc)

If your account uses oAuth 2.0 authentication, did you complete the oAuth sign-in process during setup? Imap folders will not display until the app has successfully signed in to your email providers server.

  1. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server.
  2. Tap the next button (This will test the connect to the server)
  3. OAuth Flow: Tap the Sign-in button (if displayed / prompted)

If sign-in is successfull but Inbox still doesn't display ..

  1. Open the side menu with your account folders visible.
  2. Tap manage folders (bottom of list).
  3. Tap three dot menu > refresh folder list.
  4. Tap Inbox.
  5. Check "Show folder" is enabled.


Note: This forum is focused on the mobile app. Questions related to Thunderbird desktop are best posted in the desktop forum where members with knowledge of that platform can assist you.

content:
1.) Can you please confirm what protocol your second account is using, Imap or pop3.

  • Push is only supported with Imap (using the IMAP IDLE command), enabling the server to notify the app immediately when new mail arrives. The pop protocol provides no such capability.
  • The pop3 protocol has no concept of folders. Local folders are not supported.
  • The TB/K9 mail app does not support the creation, deletion or renaming of folders.
  • For imap accounts, you can create Imap folders/labels on the server and sync these to the app. Then move emails into these folders using the app.

Are you terminating the app via Androids recent apps list? This terminates the push service and stops email synchronising reliably.

2.) The option to move/copy an email is available after you open an email from the Unified inbox.

Within the Unified Inbox...

  1. Open an email
  2. Tap the three dot menu
  3. Tap move or copy option

If the move/copy option is not displayed, you may need to enable the option. Navigate to settings > general settings > display > visible message actions.

If you have ideas to improve the app, feel free to raise your suggestions on mozilla connect where community members can vote for them.

  • Check each special folder has it's imap folder name assigned.
